In this episode, we sit down with Michigan transportation directors Tisha Hergert and Chris Ondrovick to explore their firsthand experiences transitioning to electric and propane-powered school buses. We dive into the complexities of the EPA Clean School Bus Program, from navigating infrastructure requirements to managing vehicle performance during harsh Michigan winters. Discover how these rural districts leveraged federal funding to modernize their fleets, reallocate budgets, and provide a quieter, cleaner ride for their students.
